summary: Ukrainian drones struck Wildberries logistics centers in Krasnodar and Stavropol Krai and an oil depot in Armavir, while also hitting energy infrastructure in occupied Crimea causing widespread outages. Russia struck a UNICEF warehouse in Ukraine destroying over 106,000 units of humanitarian aid worth nearly $3.9 million. Ukrainian Commander-in-Chief Oleksandr Syrsky resigned and was replaced by Mykhailo Drapatyi with a restructured General Staff.
key_points: Ukrainian drones attacked Wildberries logistics centers in Krasnodar and Stavropol Krai and an oil depot in Armavir, targeting facilities supplying drone components and dual-use goods to the Russian army. (Source: @UkraineNow/82826)
Ukrainian UAVs struck energy infrastructure in occupied Crimea (Alushta, Yalta, Feodosia, Sevastopol), causing fires at major substations and power outages. (Source: @eRadarrua/102127)
Russian forces struck a UNICEF warehouse in Ukraine, destroying over 106,000 units of humanitarian aid for children valued at nearly $3.9 million. (Source: @UkraineNow/82821)

President Zelensky appointed Mykhailo Drapatyi as new Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces, replacing Oleksandr Syrsky who resigned after liberating 700 sq km this year. (Source: @UkraineNow/82822, @UkraineNow/82825)
Ukrainian volunteer unit "Budanov's Corrals" eliminated Russian war criminal "Batman" (Roman Vnukov) in occupied Zaporizhzhia region. (Source: @UkraineNow/82820)
Russian MoD claimed liberation of Blagodatne in Zaporizhzhia region. (Source: @tass_agency/386499)
NABU and SAP charged eight individuals, including National Guard officials, with embezzling over 150 million hryvnias via inflated procurement contracts. (Source: @UkraineNow/82814)
Ukraine signed an agreement to produce BAE Systems howitzers, potentially modeling future licensed production of Western weapons like Patriot missiles. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31813)

sections.executive_summary: Ukrainian drones conducted coordinated strikes on Russian logistics hubs in Krasnodar and Stavropol Krai and an oil depot in Armavir, while simultaneously attacking energy infrastructure across occupied Crimea causing major power and water disruptions. Russia retaliated by destroying a UNICEF humanitarian warehouse in Ukraine, eliminating over 106,000 aid units valued at $3.9 million. Meanwhile, Ukraine's military leadership transitioned with Oleksandr Syrsky resigning as Commander-in-Chief after liberating 700 sq km in 2026, replaced by Mykhailo Drapatyi alongside a restructured General Staff.

points: Ukrainian drones struck Wildberries logistics centers in Krasnodar Krai and Stavropol Krai and an oil depot in Armavir, targeting facilities used to supply drone components, military navigation equipment, and dual-use goods to the Russian army. (Source: @UkraineNow/82826)

Ukrainian UAVs attacked energy infrastructure in occupied Crimea overnight July 22, hitting substations "Luchyste", "Alushta", "Darsan", and "Massandra" in Alushta, Yalta, and Feodosia, causing fires, power outages, and water supply disruptions; explosions also reported in Sevastopol. (Source: @eRadarrua/102127)

Volunteer unit "Budanov's Corrals" eliminated Russian war criminal Roman Vnukov (callsign "Batman") in occupied Zaporizhzhia region on July 20, shooting him with a silenced pistol in his car; Vnukov was deputy commander of a battalion in the 1st Army Corps "DNR" and implicated in torture, filtration camps, deportations, and forced labor. (Source: @UkraineNow/82820)

President Zelensky appointed Mykhailo Drapatyi as Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces, alongside Yevhen Khmaro and Pavlo Palisa restructuring the General Staff; outgoing Commander Oleksandr Syrsky cited liberation of 700 sq km in 2026 and an army on the offensive with initiative. (Source: @UkraineNow/82822, @UkraineNow/82825)

Ukrainian female servicemen received the first 2,000 body armor sets designed for female anatomy, marking the first procurement of gender-specific protective equipment by the Defense Procurement Agency. (Source: @UkraineNow/82812)

NABU and SAP served suspicion notices to eight individuals, including Main Directorate of National Guard officials and businessmen, for embezzling over 150 million hryvnias via inflated procurement of a food warehouse (143 million hryvnias overprice), solar stations, and tires; proceeds bought luxury cars, land near Kyiv, a 130+ sq m duplex, and Bukovel apartments. (Source: @UkraineNow/82814)

The Wall Street Journal reported Ukraine signed an agreement to produce a howitzer developed by British BAE Systems, potentially establishing a model for licensed domestic production of other Western systems including Patriot missiles. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31813)
Russian forces struck a UNICEF warehouse in Ukraine, destroying over 106,000 units of humanitarian aid for children worth nearly $3.9 million. (Source: @UkraineNow/82821)
Russian Ministry of Defense claimed liberation of the settlement of Blagodatne in Zaporizhzhia region. (Source: @tass_agency/386499)

State Duma Chairman Volodin declared Russians who fled abroad cannot be political opposition, labeling them traitors and criminals, while asserting real opposition parties are represented in parliament. (Source: @tass_agency/386482)
The State Duma adopted laws imposing restrictions on criminals and foreign agents hiding abroad, including freezing bank accounts and denying online state services. (Source: @tass_agency/386483)

Russian missile and UAV attacks targeted Odesa (three missiles and a cruise missile), Kyiv (reactive Shahed drones from the north, with 40 ballistic missiles reported on the capital), Chernihiv region (reactive UAVs along Belarus border), and other regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69295, @mon1tor_ua/69292, @mon1tor_ua/69282, @mon1tor_ua/69286, @eRadarrua/102128, @eRadarrua/102122)
Russian MoD claimed liberation of Blagodatne in Zaporizhzhia region, indicating continued offensive operations in the area. (Source: @tass_agency/386499)

Ukrainian volunteer unit "Budanov's Corrals" conducted a targeted killing of Russian war criminal "Batman" (Roman Vnukov) in occupied Zaporizhzhia region on July 20, demonstrating partisan capability behind enemy lines. (Source: @UkraineNow/82820)
Ukrainian UAV activity reported near Komyshuvakha in Zaporizhzhia region heading northwest, and reactive UAVs in Zaporizhzhia district moving north. (Source: @kpszsu/69597, @kpszsu/69601)

Multiple UAV sightings in Dnipropetrovsk region (Synelnykove district) heading northwest, and towards Kremenchuk in Poltava region from northeast, suggesting reconnaissance or strike preparations. (Source: @kpszsu/69592, @kpszsu/69581)
Reactive UAVs detected in northern Chernihiv region along the Belarus border moving westward, indicating cross-border drone activity. (Source: @kpszsu/69604)
UAVs reported near Snovsk and Koriukivka in Chernihiv region, with one heading toward Chernihiv city. (Source: @kpszsu/69630, @eRadarrua/102128)
UAVs spotted in Novgorod-Siverskyi direction in Chernihiv region from both south and northwest. (Source: @kpszsu/69592, @kpszsu/69597)
UAV activity in Shostka district of Sumy region moving southwest and from northwest direction. (Source: @kpszsu/69589, @kpszsu/69600)
Russian forces launched three missiles and a cruise missile at Odesa, with at least one impact confirmed. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69295, @mon1tor_ua/69292, @mon1tor_ua/69296)
Ukrainian reactive UAVs from the Black Sea targeted Ochakov direction in Mykolaiv region. (Source: @kpszsu/69601)
Kherson police urged drivers to avoid gathering at gas stations due to threat of Russian strikes, recommending immediate departure to shelters during air alerts. (Source: @UkraineNow/82831)

Ukrainian drones struck energy infrastructure across occupied Crimea (Alushta, Yalta, Feodosia, Sevastopol), causing fires at four major substations and widespread power and water outages. (Source: @eRadarrua/102127)

Russian reactive Shahed drones attacked Kyiv from the north, with air defenses engaged; at least one impact reported in Vyshneve/Borshchahivka area. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69282, @mon1tor_ua/69286, @mon1tor_ua/69288)
Massive Russian ballistic missile barrage on Kyiv reported (40 missiles), causing significant stress to air defense operators. (Source: @eRadarrua/102122)
Russian missile strikes on Odesa included three missiles and a cruise missile, with confirmed hits. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69295, @mon1tor_ua/69292, @mon1tor_ua/69296)
Ukrainian UAVs conducted long-range strikes on Russian logistics centers in Krasnodar and Stavropol Krai and an oil depot in Armavir. (Source: @UkraineNow/82826)
Ukrainian drones attacked energy infrastructure in occupied Crimea, hitting four major substations and causing regional blackouts. (Source: @eRadarrua/102127)

Reactive UAVs detected along Chernihiv region border with Belarus moving west; multiple UAV sightings in Chernihiv, Sumy, Zaporizhzhia, Mykolaiv, Dnipropetrovsk, and Poltava regions. (Source: @kpszsu/69604, @kpszsu/69630, @kpszsu/69592, @kpszsu/69597, @kpszsu/69589, @kpszsu/69600, @kpszsu/69601, @kpszsu/69592, @kpszsu/69581, @eRadarrua/102071)
